messages:
Teresa L: Quick sync 1: we need a concise benchmark narrative for next week's launch: focus on latency vs cost with clear next steps for self-serve vs sales routing. Deliverables: 3 chart concepts, short headline copy for each, and inbound routing rules.
Matt G: I'll prototype chart ideas today. My initial thought: 1) latency vs sequence length (bins), 2) workload comparison (interactive chat vs batch), 3) savings waterfall showing staging of optimizations (batching, KV, quantization).
Elaine: Sequence length chart resonates with engineers. Also recommend a compact "savings ladder" graphic that stacks impact of batching + caching for a single workload example.
Srini: Add a tiny schematic for fallback routing: hosted primary -> if latency > threshold or error rate high -> fallback to dedicated/different model; annotate cost delta so it stays in economic framing.
Josh: Routing and CTA ideas: Self-serve CTA = "Try Hosted Free Tier". Enterprise CTA = "Request Dedicated Eval". Routing rule: trial accounts over 100k tokens/day or company domains in the enterprise list should auto-tag and surface to sales.
Teresa L: Need pithy chart headlines. Drafts: A) "When sequence length drives latency (and costs)" B) "Chat vs Batch: where dollars accumulate" C) "Optimization waterfall: latency wins, dollars saved"
Matt G: Chart specs draft:
- Chart A (sequence bins): x = sequence length bins (0-64, 65-256, 257-1024), primary y = ms/token, secondary y = $/1M tokens (overlay). Include sample query labels per bin.
- Chart B (workload): grouped bars for chat vs batch showing latency and $/1M tokens for base and quantized model variants.
- Chart C (waterfall): start with baseline cost/latency, then arrows showing % improvements after batching, caching, quantization (stacked savings).
Elaine: UX notes: make Chart A color-blind safe, label sample queries (e.g., quick reply, email draft, long doc generation). Include short footnote with baseline model and hardware to avoid misinterpretation.
Srini: For messaging A/B test: Variant A = engineer-first (bench numbers + config tips). Variant B = outcome-first (customer scenarios, clear CTAs). We'll measure landing conversion and lead quality; route heavy usage to sales.
Teresa L: Routing workflow draft: all trials -> 7-day marketing nurture. If any of these conditions met, route to sales: daily tokens > 100k OR domain in enterprise allowlist OR webinar attendance > 2 sessions. Ops-bot to tag with "dedicated-consider" and push an event to CRM that includes a chart snapshot and observed qps.
ops-bot: (automated) Creating workflow "bench-launch-routing" and will emit events to #crm when criteria are met.
Josh: Webinar concept: "Cut inference costs without sacrificing latency" 1: gated signup, interactive slider for sequence length to show cost delta. Heavy attendees get routed to SDRs.
Matt G: Timeline: chart mocks by EOD today, landing + webinar copy by tomorrow noon, A/B deploy by Wednesday.
Teresa L: Owners: Matt = charts + interactive mock, Elaine = accessibility + query labels, Srini = A/B + metrics, Josh = CTA + CRM mapping, ops-bot = automation. I'll collate into a PR and post slide draft here.
Elaine: Please add baseline note: LlamaX-7B (fp16), NVIDIA H100 perf profile, and token cost assumptions in slide notes.
Josh: I'll assemble the inbound filter list and update CRM mapping once ops-bot workflow is live.
Teresa L: Thanks all 1: will post PR link shortly and assign review for the slide deck.
